family.$description: Font family per script. Platform files (platform/*.json) hold sizes, line heights and role weights.

en.$description: Inter — Latin text on every platform (weights 400 / 500 / 600).

ar.$description: IBM Plex Sans Arabic — Arabic text on every platform (weights 400 / 500 / 600). Selected automatically for lang="ar".

mono.$description: JetBrains Mono — the code role only: IDs, serial numbers, keys, codes. Latin characters only.
